name: Kobayakawa Serina
source:
A nurse who began working at “Date Clinic” on Reimi’s recommendation. Unlike the other two, she volunteered to work there of her own accord.

In fact, she is a former patient whose life was saved by the protagonist in the past; ever since then, she has been deeply in love with him and has been striving to become a nurse.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130303161514/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/r3/char.html]archived official site[/url]]
